info.name: Returns a list of BackupIQ alerts based on filtering, ordering and paging criteria.

params.name: is_muted
params.description:
Indicates that alert is muted on UI by settings of alerts specified on the portal.
Muted alerts are not displayed on the portal UI.
API returns not muted alerts by default.

params.name: customer_id
params.description: The id of the customer in UUID format.

params.name: customer_name
params.description: The name of the customer. All of the customers that contain passed parameter will be in filtered result.

params.name: appliance_name
params.description: The name of the appliance. All of the appliances that contain passed parameter will be in filtered result.

params.name: asset_name
params.description: The name of the asset. All of the asset that contain passed parameter will be in filtered result.

params.name: asset_key
params.description: The unique identifier of the asset.

params.name: job_name
params.description: The name of the job. All of the jobs that contain passed parameter will be in filtered result.

params.name: job_type
params.description: The type of the job. All of the jobs that contain passed parameter will be in filtered result.

params.name: is_dismissed
params.description:
Flag that indicates dismiss status of an alert. It means whether a user dismissed an alert in BackupIQ interface.
The absence of the parameter leads to both dismissed and not dismissed alerts in the filtered result.

params.name: created_time_direction
params.description: Direction of ordering by created_time field, which always the second ordering field. E.g. "asc", "desc".

items.docs: Visibility is restricted by tenant which issued credentials for access.
